manifest.scope: Local held-out video evaluation; fixed before outputs or scores for these trajectories are observed.

cases.prompt: A space shuttle launching into orbit, with flames and smoke billowing out from the engines
Iron Man flying in the sky
time lapse of sunrise on mars.

selection.rule: Sort source by case_id, remove normalized excluded texts and duplicates (keep first eligible occurrence), random.Random(20261110).shuffle, take first eight. No result-based selection or category balancing.
selection.text_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, retain alphanumeric characters only

generated_roots.policy: Union of inventory-recorded existing case directories and current MP4 case IDs; conservative local history exclusion, no video contents/scores read.
Union of inventory-recorded existing case directories and current MP4 case IDs; conservative local history exclusion, no video contents/scores read.

Union of inventory-recorded existing case directories and current MP4 case IDs; conservative local history exclusion, no video contents/scores read.

selection.limits: Only this project's explicitly listed local histories are excluded. Public VBench texts are not globally unseen, and normalization does not establish semantic disjointness.

arms.name: plain
arms.recipe: E022 untrained original-mainweight NVFP4 export; no online LR

arms.name: svd_lr
arms.recipe: Frozen E008/E021 full SVD+LR recipe, not an LR-only causal control

arms.name: qad_native_dev_selected
arms.rule: Minimum native development pooled NMSE among steps 0,32,64,128; exact tie chooses earlier step. Bind selected_step, selected_packed_file and selected_packed_sha256 from the completed frozen trainer selection.

checkpoint_binding.policy: Create a separate binding record from the completed trainer candidate_selection artifact and its SHA; do not change prompts, seeds or the selection rule. If step0 wins, retain that choice and explicitly report identity with plain; never substitute step128.

manifest.shared_randomness: For each trajectory save one actual initial FP64 latent, four FP32 update noises and its shared BF16 text embedding; every arm loads those same tensors and evolves independently. Across prompts and replicas the CUDA generators have distinct fixed seeds. No teacher-state injection.

evaluation_policy.reporting: Per prompt and replica first; aggregate the two replicas within prompt before an equal-weight eight-prompt mean. Preserve BF16 failures and all metric tradeoffs; no filtering of low-quality cases.
evaluation_policy.checkpoints: Only the four primary arms. Fixed step128 is not added as a secondary arm in this protocol.
evaluation_policy.metrics: Reuse the fixed E021 AMT/RAFT/DINO and MJ four primary statistics as separate diagnostics. No new composite quality score or winner-based prompt/checkpoint replacement.

limits: Fixed local held-out text split, not globally unseen.
SVD is a whole-recipe reference; no LR-only causal claim.
Diagnostic wall times are not deployment benchmarks.

plain_step0000_binding.source_report_policy: Only the immutable exports[step=0] record is copied; no hash of the live training report.
